initialization: discard offset 9x9 region center+(64,64) using same seeded generator before timing
measurement: one discarded initialized process per executable per case, then five alternating baseline/candidate pairs; terrain+decoration normalized by 256 terrain chunks, 196 decorated interior chunks
cold: separate one-worker overworld five alternating pairs without offset initialization if primary gate passes
early_stop: stop after primary gate if no repeatable >=5% whole-terrain reduction
